title: Platform Follow-up
transcript:
[00:00] Priya: Quick follow-up. The Postgres migration is delayed by two weeks because of the vendor review.
[00:22] Marcus: That's a schedule change, not a database change. We're still using Postgres.
[00:38] Priya: Right. We'll use Redis for caching.
[00:52] Marcus: I'll finish the benchmark by November 16.
[01:05] Priya: I'll draft the schema by November 6.
[01:18] Elena: The beta launch is scheduled for December 4. Keep that date for now.
